DO YOU LIKE MOSTIMA FROM ARKNIGHTS????[/center]

Well I sure do, because I made a mod that puts her in Stardew Valley because I've been hyperfixated on her for like four and a half years and the time of writing this. Anyways, it spiraled out of control and now there are fifteen of the wretched beasts. If you make fun of my crappy pixel art skills I [i]WILL[/i] start ugly crying and probably throw up on the carpet. You have been warned. Requests are welcome, but please be patient! Not super familiar with pixel art yet, so it'll probably take a while.
